# nginxproxymanager_custom_certificate (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nginxproxymanager_custom_certificate" "example" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the certificate.

### Optional

- `intermediate_certificate` (String) Intermediate certificate in the chain. **This is implemented to be consistent with the Certificate Resource, but will always be blank as it's not returned by the API.**

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) Body of the certificate in PEM format.
- `certificate_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key of the certificate in PEM format.
- `nice_name` (String) Nice name for the certificate.
